description: This file defines the class GridLayoutMetaDataParser, a PHP class responsible for parsing, manipulating, and saving layout metadata for grid-based views in the SuiteCRM Module Builder. It implements functions to handle layout structures, field placement, panel configurations, tab settings, and conversion between internal and canonical formats, primarily to support customization and dynamic layout editing.

classes.name: GridLayoutMetaDataParser
classes.description: A PHP class for parsing and managing grid layout metadata in SuiteCRM, providing methods for layout retrieval, modification, conversion, and storage.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with view type, module, and optional package, setting up internal data structures and loading view definitions.

methods.name: writeWorkingFile
methods.description: Saves the current layout configuration as a draft (working) file.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Deploys the current layout updates to the system, optionally updating from request data.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the complete layout with filler fields added for display purposes.

methods.name: getTabDefs
methods.description: Returns definitions related to tabs and panels, such as whether a panel uses tabs and if it is collapsed.

methods.name: setTabDefs
methods.description: Sets the tab definitions in the layout.

methods.name: getMaxColumns
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of columns allowed in the layout.

methods.name: getAvailableFields
methods.description: Provides a list of fields available for inclusion in the layout, excluding those already used.

methods.name: getPanelDependency
methods.description: Returns the dependency configuration of a specific panel.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a new field to a specified or default panel within the layout.

methods.name: removeField
methods.description: Removes all instances of a specified field from the layout, replacing them with filler fields, and potentially removing empty rows or panels.

methods.name: setPanelDependency
methods.description: Sets a dependency condition for a specified panel.

methods.name: getFirstNewPanelId
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next available unique panel ID for new panels.

methods.name: _populateFromRequest
methods.description: Loads layout data from the HTTP request and updates internal layout definitions accordingly.

methods.name: _convertToCanonicalForm
methods.description: Converts internal layout format to the canonical metadata layout used by SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _convertFromCanonicalForm
methods.description: Converts the canonical SuiteCRM layout data into the internal format.

methods.name: getFieldsFromLayout
methods.description: Extracts field identifiers from a given layout definition.

methods.name: fieldIsRequired
methods.description: Determines whether a field is marked as required based on its definition.

methods.name: _trimFieldDefs
methods.description: Simplifies field definition arrays to keep only relevant properties.

methods.name: getUseTabs
methods.description: Returns whether the layout uses tabs.

methods.name: setUseTabs
methods.description: Sets whether to use tabs in the layout.

methods.name: getSyncDetailEditViews
methods.description: Returns whether the Detail and Edit views are synchronized.

methods.name: setSyncDetailEditViews
methods.description: Sets synchronization between Detail and Edit views.

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying metadata implementation object.

methods.name: convertFromCanonicalForm
methods.description: Public wrapper for converting canonical layout data into internal format.

methods.name: convertToCanonicalForm
methods.description: Public wrapper for converting internal layout data into SuiteCRM canonical format.

methods.name: getCalculatedFields
methods.description: Returns list of fields marked as calculated with formulas.

methods.name: getFieldsInPanel
methods.description: Returns all fields within a specific panel as an array.
